description: Polish the chat UI to feel more like ChatGPT/Claude: smoother loading states, better message spacing, regenerate button on AI responses, improved copy feedback, and compact response rendering that does not overwhelm the viewport.
steps: STEP 1 - Add a 'Regenerate' button next to the copy button on AI analysis bubbles. In the addAIBubble function (around line 1466 in index.html), when isStructured is true, add a regenerate button: '<button onclick="regenerateLastAnalysis(this)" class="copy-btn px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 border border-transparent hover:border-emerald-500/30 transition-all">Ulang</button>'. Implement regenerateLastAnalysis(btn) that: (a) finds the previous user message, (b) re-triggers the same analysis with the same parameters, (c) replaces the current AI bubble with new response.

STEP 2 - Improve the loading state. Replace the simple 'Menganalisis...' text with a multi-step progress indicator. Update addLoadingBubble to show: 'Membaca data...' (0-2s) then 'Menganalisis chart...' (2-5s) then 'Menyusun rekomendasi...' (5s+). Use setInterval to cycle through these messages. This makes the wait feel shorter and more interactive, similar to ChatGPT's streaming feel.

STEP 3 - Add typing effect for short chat responses (not structured analysis). In addAIBubble, when isStructured is false AND html length < 500, render the text character-by-character with a 10ms delay to simulate typing. For longer responses and structured analysis, render immediately (no typing effect - it would be too slow). Add a flag to skip effect when restoring from history.

STEP 4 - Improve message spacing and bubble styling. Change the chat-messages space-y-4 to space-y-3 for tighter spacing. For AI analysis bubbles (isStructured=true), add a subtle top label: '

Analisis

' before the content. For follow-up responses, no label needed. This visually distinguishes full analyses from chat responses.

STEP 5 - Make structured analysis responses collapsible. Wrap the AI analysis content in a container that shows the Score & Decision section always visible, with the rest expandable. Add: '
[Score & Decision section]
[rest of sections]
'. On first render, show fully expanded. On history restore, show collapsed. Implement toggleAnalysisExpand to toggle visibility.

STEP 6 - Fix copy button to also work with collapsed/expanded content. Update copyBubbleContent to get text from both .analysis-preview and .analysis-full (even if hidden). Ensure the copied text is complete regardless of collapse state.
acceptance_criteria: Regenerate button appears on structured AI analysis bubbles
regenerateLastAnalysis function re-sends the analysis request and replaces the response
Loading bubble shows progressive messages (Membaca data / Menganalisis / Menyusun rekomendasi)
Short chat responses have a subtle typing effect
Structured analyses are collapsible with toggle button
Copy works correctly on both collapsed and expanded analysis
All inline JS passes syntax validation
Existing chat, sidebar, mode dropdown still work
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('/projects/sandbox/auto-cuan/index.html','utf8'); if(!html.includes('regenerateLastAnalysis')) throw 'Missing regenerate'; if(!html.includes('Membaca data')) throw 'Missing loading steps'; if(!html.includes('toggleAnalysisExpand')) throw 'Missing collapsible'; console.log('FEAT-003 checks passed');"
findings: Implemented all 6 sub-features: (1) Regenerate button with lastAnalysisParams global var tracking last analysis call, (2) Progressive loading messages cycling through 3 stages with setInterval, (3) Typing effect for short non-structured responses using 4-char groups at 15ms, (4) Analisis label for structured bubbles, (5) Collapsible analysis splitting at Action Plan section with toggle button, (6) Updated copyBubbleContent to concatenate preview+full text. addAIBubble now takes 3 params (html, isStructured, fromHistory). All callers that produce real-time results still work fine without the third param (defaults to undefined/falsy).
